description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to land parcel in Beliattha west, Beliattha D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830136 and other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act, dealing specifically with land ownership, possession interests, cadastral maps, and land title determinations.
